title.en: Estimated planetary Kp is 0.33 (quiet) at 11:00 UTC on 23 September 2026.
title.zh: 2026 年 9 月 23 日 11:00 UTC，估計行星 Kp 為 0.33（平靜）。

summary.en: Latest reliable hour-start estimated Kp is 0.33 (0P) at 11:00 UTC on 23 September. The 11:00 hour is complete (60 samples through 11:59; hour-start 0.33/0P, hour-end 0.67/1M). Last-180 maximum is 1.00 (first at 2026-09-23 11:42 UTC; label 1Z; last-180 window from 09:05 UTC). Published-window maximum is 1.00 (first at 2026-09-23 11:42 UTC; label 1Z). Window start 2026-09-23 06:08 UTC (357 samples). estimated_kp remains below 5.0. The 12:00 UTC hour is still incomplete (5 samples through 12:04) and is not used as the main card.
summary.zh: 最後可靠整點估計 Kp 為 0.33（0P），取樣 2026-09-23 11:00 UTC。11:00 時段已收滿 60 筆（至 11:59，時段初 0.33／0P、時段末 0.67／1M）。近 180 筆最大 1.00（最先見於 2026-09-23 11:42 UTC；標籤 1Z；近 180 筆窗自 09:05 UTC 起）；公開窗最大 1.00（最先見於 2026-09-23 11:42 UTC；標籤 1Z）。窗起點 2026-09-23 06:08 UTC（357 筆）。estimated_kp 仍低於 5.0。12:00 UTC 時段尚未收滿（至 12:04 僅 5 筆），不作為主卡片。

evidence.method: Read the public 1-minute estimated planetary K-index JSON. Use the latest published hour-start minute of a completed hour that is not a trailing incomplete placeholder (11:00 UTC on 23 September). Report last-180 and full published-window maxima.
evidence.limitations: estimated_kp is a near-real-time estimate, not the final observatory Kp. The public file is a rolling ~6-hour window and older samples drop off. Hour-start 11:00 UTC is 0.33/0P; the hour ends 0.67/1M at 11:59. A 1.00/1Z sample appears at 2026-09-23 11:42 UTC.

title.en: A magnitude 5.3 earthquake occurred 51 km WSW of Arauco, Argentina on 23 September 2026.
title.zh: 2026 年 9 月 23 日，阿根廷 Arauco 西南偏西約 51 公里發生規模 5.3 地震。

summary.en: USGS M4.5+ day feed: mww 5.3, depth about 122 km. This event is also the current day-feed maximum.
summary.zh: USGS M4.5+ 一日饋送：mww 5.3，深度約 122 公里。此事件同時為一日饋送目前最大。

evidence.method: Added from the public USGS all-day M4.5+ GeoJSON feed when the event first appeared in the rolling 24-hour window.
evidence.limitations: Magnitudes and locations can be revised by USGS. The day feed only retains recent M4.5+ events.
